meta.source: Derived from a Heron AI brand extraction (heronaiapp.com: home, chat widget, resources, insights).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Void = the reference's near-black #101010; Paper = the reference's #FFFFFF background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section bands and alternating table rows. Paper = the reference's warm surface #F5F5ED.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, menus, chart plots. Paper = the reference's button background #F0F0F0.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs and code wells, one step below the ground.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and table row rules only — decorative, never a control border.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline: panel frames, dividers, card borders. Paper = the reference's border #B3B3AF (2.1:1 on white — a decorative rule, not a control edge; use line-strong for controls).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges (inputs, outline buttons, segmented controls): ≥3:1 on bg and surface in both themes. The reference's #72726F.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on bg, surface, surface-raised. Paper = the reference's primary #282828; Void inverts to its warm surface #F5F5ED.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy under headlines, table text, on any surface. Paper = the reference's secondary #414140.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, axis labels, metadata, the flat (0.00%) state; ≥4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes. Paper = the reference's granite gray #626260.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast). Paper = the reference's #B4B4B0.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: MoneyView Signal Orange, the reference's #FA3600. Fills: primary button, selection, focus ring, the highlighted chart series, the active nav underline. Never on price changes.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand as text (links, index numbers in eyebrows) on bg, surface and surface-raised — ≥4.5:1 in both themes, where raw brand is not.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind brand-text: selected rows, active chips.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. Near-black, 5.0:1 — white on #FA3600 is only 3.8:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus ring, 2px offset; ≥3:1 on every ground in both themes (reference: inputs focus to the brand).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Hover shifts color toward ink (the reference's color-shift).

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: 상승 Up — price rise, positive change, gains. Korean market convention (red = up). Always paired with ▲ and a + sign. ≥4.5:1 on bg/surface/surface-raised.

tokens.name: up-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind up text; heatmap low-intensity up cells.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: 하락 Down — price fall, negative change, losses. Korean convention (blue = down). Always paired with ▼ and a − sign. ≥4.5:1 on bg/surface/surface-raised.

tokens.name: down-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind down text; heatmap low-intensity down cells.

tokens.name: flat
tokens.usage: 보합 Unchanged — 0.00% and missing data.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series 1 — the subject series (the one asset the chart is about).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series 2 — signal cyan; benchmark or comparison line. ≥3:1 against bg in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series 3 — sand; secondary comparison, area fills under a line.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series 4 — neutral; 'everything else', the market average.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series 5 — amber; a fifth series only when unavoidable.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: The reference's BT Grotesk scale (62/53/44/36/31/27), set in Host Grotesk for Latin and Pretendard for Hangul. Korean headlines take the same size; keep line length ≤ 18 Hangul syllables.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles on the landing page.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: 18px is the reference body. Line height opened to 1.67 for Hangul readability.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: MoneyView는 주식과 시장 전체가 선호하는 추세를 한 화면에서 보여줍니다.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 거시 지표와 섹터 흐름을 함께 읽습니다.
styles.usage: Dense UI text, form help, card copy. (Addition: the reference has no step under 18px for sans.)

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels and emphasized inline text.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Geist Mono 500 — the reference's mono, exactly. Every number on the site is set in mono with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: KPI figures in stat cards. (Addition: big numerals.)

styles.name: mono-link
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, CTA links — the reference's 16px mono link. Uppercase for English.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Table cells, tickers, deltas, tooltips. The reference's 13px mono text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Eyebrows, axis labels, table headers, timestamps. Uppercase English; Korean captions at 12px.

spacing.note: The reference runs on a 4.44px step (0.4rem at an 11.11px root) used at ×1 2 3 4 5 6 8 16. MoneyView keeps those multipliers on a whole-pixel 4px base so table rows and chart axes land on device pixels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, delta glyph gap. (ref 4.44px)

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Input padding top/right/bottom, chip padding. (ref 8.89px)

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding, tight stacks. (ref 13.33px)

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input left padding, table cell horizontal padding, card inner gaps. (ref 17.78px)

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on mobile. (ref 22.22px)

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, grid gutter. (ref 26.67px)

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked panels, heading to content. (ref 35.56px)

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap inside a landing section between title block and content. (ref 71.11px)

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Vertical padding between landing sections on desktop (64px under 768px). Addition: landing rhythm.

radius.note: The extraction reports no radii; the reference reads square-cornered with hairline frames, so MoneyView stays near-square.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, charts, section frames — the default.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Tooltips, menus, delta chips.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Live-status dot and the ticker's market-open pill only.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: ≥992: 12-column grid, side-by-side chart + table.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: 768–991: 6 columns, charts stack above tables.

tokens.name: bp-mobile
tokens.usage: <768: single column, 16px gutters; tables scroll horizontally inside their panel.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Grid gutter (16px under 768px).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule. No 2px borders except the focus ring.
